dedupe_keys.name: ecd uy uruguay household electricity consumption

description: ECD-UY supplies household electricity observations collected by UTE and studied at Universidad de la Republica in Uruguay, mainly around Montevideo. It separates total household demand, electric water-heater consumption and appliance-level measurements, with sampling intervals from one to fifteen minutes. Figshare groups customer and appliance reference tables, monthly demand files, compressed full records and smaller uncompressed samples. All 55 inspected collection members state CC0, allowing free access and reuse. Calendar coverage differs across subsets and files, not forming one uniform panel. These observations can calibrate residential demand, water-heating flexibility and tariff-response simulations, complementing data-uk-dale-domestic-appliance-level-electricity. A caveat is that reduced samples and full files must not be pooled as independent observations. Household identifiers, available attributes and missing intervals also need consistent treatment before comparing subsets. The provider's handling notebooks are a separate software resource. Only landing metadata and file inventories were inspected; no customer or consumption table was downloaded.
